environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.micro) running as a systemd service under the 'authsvc' user. SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0 was run during initial deployment troubleshooting and never reverted). The service listens directly on port 8443 with no reverse proxy or rate limiting. Network security group allows inbound TCP/8443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The instance has no additional MAC policies or network-level timing obfuscation.
